opportunities.name: Laser hybrid artillery
opportunities.objective: Test laser hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Ultrashock Laser has 0.5 AP and total-AD physical damage and terrain hits force its special crit; R adds 1.1 AP magic damage while E adds AP-scaled magic on-hit. Gunblade retains AD and earned Muramana supports physical spell poke, with Serylda matching physical W rather than R.
opportunities.requiredState: Find safe terrain laser angles and save E for repositioning.
opportunities.failure: Weak ordinary Q attack scaling and reduced sustained crit lose extended fights.
opportunities.test: Measure terrain W physical damage separately from R/E magic packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Legacy Q missiles contain AP terms, but primary Q has no AP term; do not promote helpers to live damage.

opportunities.name: Burst Fire health bruiser
opportunities.objective: Test burst fire health bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Burst Fire is explicitly treated as an attack and scales 1.02-1.1 total AD; Bloodmail and Titanic test health-backed physical Q attacks while Cleaver supports shred. Hexplate synchronizes with R's speed window, but item trigger effectiveness must be checked on the whole Q burst.
opportunities.requiredState: Hit moving Q bursts and maintain R through champion contact.
opportunities.failure: Low crit loses extra Overcharge stacks and E cooldown refunds.
opportunities.test: Count Q item packets, E refunds and R uptime during a moving ten-second chase.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Seven Q rounds are not seven full independent item on-hits, and passive attacks are treated as abilities.

ruledOut.reason: Legacy Q missiles contain AP terms, but primary Q has no AP term; do not promote helpers to live damage.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: Laser hybrid artillery
builds.summary: Test laser hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test laser hybrid artillery against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Ultrashock Laser has 0.5 AP and total-AD physical damage and terrain hits force its special crit; R adds 1.1 AP magic damage while E adds AP-scaled magic on-hit. Gunblade retains AD and earned Muramana supports physical spell poke, with Serylda matching physical W rather than R.
testPlan: Required state: Find safe terrain laser angles and save E for repositioning.
Measure terrain W physical damage separately from R/E magic packets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Weak ordinary Q attack scaling and reduced sustained crit lose extended fights.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Legacy Q missiles contain AP terms, but primary Q has no AP term; do not promote helpers to live damage.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Gunblade, Rabadon's Deathcap, Spear of Shojin, Serylda's Grudge, Muramana, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Zeri's Attacks are treated as Abilities instead of Attacks and can be charged up by moving and casting {{Spell_ZeriQ_Name}}. Uncharged Attacks consume a small amount of charge, deal @Spell.ZeriQ:MinDamage@ magic damage and execute enemies below @Spell.ZeriQ:PassiveExecuteThreshold@ Health. A fully charged Attack deals @Spell.ZeriQ:PassiveMaxDamage@ + @Spell.ZeriQ:PassiveMaxChargePercentHealth@ max Health magic damage and consumes all charge.
Zeri fires a burst of [7] rounds that deals [22 / 26 / 30 / 34 / 38 + (1.02 / 1.04 / 1.06 / 1.08 / 1.1) × AD] physical damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.

Zeri fires an electric pulse that deals [30 / 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 + (1) × AD + (0.5) × AP] physical damage and Slows the first enemy hit by [(0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5) × 100]% for [2] seconds.

If the pulse hits terrain, it expands into a laser that applies the effects in an area and Critically Strikes champions and monsters for [(30 / 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 + (1) × AD + (0.5) × AP) × ((1 + (0.5) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage.

Zeri discharges a nova of electricity, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (1.1) × AP + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits an enemy champion, Zeri gains [30]% Attack Speed and [15]% Move Speed for [5] seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability extends this ability's duration and adds a stack of Overcharge for [2.5] seconds. Critical strikes add 2 additional stacks. Each stack grants [1.5]% Move Speed.

During this time, {{Spell_ZeriQ_Name}} becomes a faster triple shot that chains [(0.4) × AD] physical damage to nearby enemies.

Zeri dashes a short distance and vaults over any terrain she touches, greatly extending the dash range. For the next [5] seconds, her shots of {{Spell_ZeriQ_Name}} pierce dealing [(0.8 / 0.85 / 0.9 / 0.95 / 1) × 100]% damage to enemies after the first and an additional [(22 / 24 / 26 / 28 / 30 + (0.2) × AP) × ((1 + ((1) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] magic damage On-Hit to the first target struck. 

Hitting an enemy with an Attack reduces this Ability's cooldown by [0.5] seconds. Critical strikes reduce the cooldown by [1.5] seconds instead.
